resources.string: Privacy Policy
Arkiroku Privacy Policy
Last updated: October 5, 2026

Thank you for using Arkiroku (hereinafter referred to as "this app"). We take your privacy very seriously and understand that your trust is very important to us. Therefore, in accordance with legal requirements and well-established industry security standards, we protect your personal information in reasonable and effective ways.
Through this Privacy Policy, we will help you understand the efforts we make in collecting, using, storing, sharing and protecting your personal information.

If you have any questions about the content of this Privacy Policy, please contact us in the manner described in "9. Contact Us" and we will reply to you as soon as possible; if you do not agree with the content of this Privacy Policy, please stop using this app.
1. Information We Collect
During operation, this app may involve the following data:

1. TapTap account credentials: When you choose to log in by scanning the QR code with TapTap, this app obtains the sessionToken authorized by TapTap, which is used to read your game save data from the Phigros cloud server.
2. Phigros game save: including your in-game nickname, Course Mode rating, play records (scores, accuracy, Full Combo status, etc.) and RKS values.
3. Local settings preferences: including your selected theme mode, the local URI of your custom avatar, B30 overflow display settings, etc.

4. Runtime logs (Debug builds only): The Debug build provides a feature to export runtime logs. These logs are used to troubleshoot issues and may contain technical information related to network requests (in certain cases, account credential fields such as the sessionToken may appear). Please share logs only through channels you trust, and review and redact them yourself before making them public.

5. Phi-Plugin "滦鸠" joint score lookup API request credentials (optional): When you choose to enable the "Enable score lookup API" feature on the settings page, this app will send requests to that API based on the "Platform Name", "Platform ID", "API User ID" and "API Token" you filled in, to obtain the corresponding score lookup data.
2. How We Use Your Data
Your data is used only for the following purposes:
• Read and display your Phigros game save and score analysis (B30, RKS calculation, etc.).
• Store your personalized settings so that they can be restored the next time the app starts.
• Cache illustration resources to reduce network traffic consumption.

• Based on the platform name, platform ID, API user ID and API Token you filled in after enabling the score lookup API feature, send requests to that API to obtain the corresponding score lookup data.
3. Data Storage and Security
All data is stored locally on your device. This app does not upload your data to any remote server under our control.
Specifically:
• Game save and score data are stored in the app's local Room database.
• Settings preferences are stored in Android SharedPreferences.
• Illustration cache is stored in the app's dedicated cache directory.

• Sensitive information such as the sessionToken and API Token is stored in the keystore of the operating system you use, and is not transmitted in any form to any third party other than TapTap or the score lookup API.

However, please understand that the Internet is not an absolutely secure environment, and no security measure is foolproof. We recommend that you take proactive measures to protect the security of your personal information.
4. Third-Party Services
During operation, this app interacts with the following third-party services:
1. TapTap OAuth service: used to implement QR code login and obtain authorization credentials. The interaction process follows TapTap's privacy policy.
2. Phigros cloud save service (LeanCloud): used to read your game save data.
3. GitHub (raw.githubusercontent.com): used to fetch illustration image resources and index data updates.
4. gh-proxy (gh-proxy.com): used to speed up requests and obtain GitHub resources in mainland China.
5. Phi-Plugin "滦鸠" joint score lookup API (optional): used to obtain leaderboards, RKS history and other data.
This app does not use any third-party analytics, advertising or tracking SDKs.
5. Your Rights
You may at any time:
• Log out to clear the account credentials stored locally.
• Clear locally cached illustration resources in Settings.
• Clear all local data of this app through the "App info" feature of the Android system.
• Uninstall this app to completely delete all related data.
6. Children's Privacy

We attach great importance to the protection of minors' personal information. In accordance with relevant laws and regulations, if you are a minor under the age of 18, you should, together with your guardian, read and agree to this Privacy Policy under the supervision and guidance of your guardian before using our services.

We will only obtain, store, use, share, transfer or disclose minors' personal information where permitted by law, with the explicit consent of the minor's guardian, or where necessary to protect the minor. If you are the guardian of a minor and have questions about the personal information of the minor under your guardianship, please contact us through the contact information published in this Privacy Policy.
7. Updates to This Privacy Policy

We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. The updated Privacy Policy will be released along with app version updates. We recommend that you review this Privacy Policy regularly to stay informed of the latest information.
8. Third-Party Privacy Policies
We list below the privacy policies of the third-party services we use; you can tap the links below to view them:
1. TapTap OAuth service & LeanCloud: https://www.taptap.cn/doc/privacy-policy/
2. Phigros: https://phigros.pigeongames.cn/privacy_policy.txt
3. GitHub: https://docs.github.com/zh/site-policy/privacy-policies/github-general-privacy-statement
4. Gh-Proxy: https://gh-proxy.com/privacy
5. Joint score lookup API: https://www.phib19.top/privacy
9. Contact Us
If you have any questions or suggestions about this Privacy Policy, please contact us through the following:
• GitHub Issues: https://github.com/Kasumi-Ushio/Ushio-Prober-Phigros/issues
• Email: asahinahotaruchan@gmail.com
